reviewer: AI visual review; not independent human ground truth
purpose: Conservative visible-action cores for a prototype. Not exhaustive action-onset or intent annotations.

label_policy.WAIT: No hand on or over tabletop, including its edges.
label_policy.INTERACTION: Visible workpiece manipulation/stabilization or task-tool handling.
label_policy.PASSTHRU: Hand/arm passing through workspace without visible workpiece/tool handling; brief pauses within a pass may be retained.

excluded_frames: All frames outside listed cores are excluded from this reviewed selection, not reassigned to WAIT. Original frames are retained. Static tabletop intrusion needs an explicit policy before inclusion.
integration_note: Review manifest only. Repository loader must enforce these ranges or use separately materialized trimmed folders before training. Do not point training at full imported folders and assume ranges are applied. Timing and split setup remain subsequent steps.
